methods: Read-only service and source metadata inspection
Source hash comparison against pinned Sovol snapshot
result: Host and running firmware identified; local archive verified; temperature mismatch confirmed by owner external measurement, sensor identity unresolved

thermal_observations.external_measurement_method: External tool; model, accuracy and measurement point unspecified

source_comparison.scope: Vendor-listed .py/.c/.h files under klippy and src, compared on the installed host

preservation.archive_capture_limitation: Live klippy.log changed during capture; tar exit 1; not an atomic snapshot

limits: No heat, motion, probing, flashing or restart commanded by this inspection
MCU target strings do not prove chip suffix or flash capacity
Runtime clock is distinct from external oscillator frequency
On-disk AVR build configuration does not match running STM32 firmware
Raw captures and unique identities excluded from version control
